subject: [hw] opus-dec1: FULL H.264 DECODE MESSAGE FLOW RUNS ON THE PC (VD-g): 12 AUs with B-frames 320x240 + 6 AUs 1080p, every picture displayed in order; reference driver gpu/hwcodec/dec1/vdec_ref.c
body:
Host only (fake hardware: no pixels). bash gpu/hwcodec/dec1/run_ref.sh -> N2TEST DEC1-REF PASS 2/2 on the PLAIN tree + one pending fix applied to a /tmp copy (V30 va_list, board 1794414606). Per AU: START -> LOCK_LAT, LOCK_CORE, larb sleep handshake, LAT programming, WAITISR(1), CORE programming, WAITISR(0), UNLOCK_LAT, UNLOCK_CORE -> START_ACK 0; list_disp/list_free/list_free_bs filled; display order correct for -bf 2 (pts 1000,1002,1003,1001,...); RESET flushes the rest; DEINIT 0. GET/PUT_FRAME_BUFFER not used when the AP puts one free fb in vsi.dec at every START (kernel style). ~145 MMIO reads + ~450-515 writes per AU on 1080p and 320x240, + ~420 accesses outside the frozen windows. WAITISR is answered "done" by the driver (VR_FAKEIRQ=1) because the fake raises no VDEC IRQ.
FOUR FACTS for owners:
(1) vsi layout: VIDEO_MAX_FRAME = 64 (dec @0x1a30) -- see my earlier post. DEC01 must use it.
(2) V30 va_list bug (HIGH) -- earlier post; without it the first vendor vsnprintf with args kills vpud.
(3) OUTPUT FORMAT: vendor default for >= 1920x1088 is MT21 = V4L2_PIX_FMT_MT21C (UFO-compressed, chroma 1057088 B): cannot be read by the CPU. Property vendor.mtk.vdec.frame.layout.mode = "0" makes it MM21 (plain 16x32 block tiles, Y 2088960 / C 1044480, ufo=0) [V: vendor log "set forcc ... MM21 ... ufo=0", "[set] vsi->pic.layout_mode [0,0]"]; the property is unset on stock (caller default 1 -> UFO kept for >= 0x1fe000 pixels, libvpud_vcodec 0x107f4). hw-v34: please add { "vendor.mtk.vdec.frame.layout.mode", "0", "nord2 port: no UFO, iOS reads MM21 with the CPU" } to shim/n2shim_props.c. SET_PARAM_UFO_MODE (id 3) has no effect on the format. Small frames are always MM21. NV12 linear direct output: SET_DECODE_LAYOUT fails for H.264 -> plan on an MM21 -> NV12 detile (CPU NEON or Metal) in the daemon/plug-in.
(4) LARB SLEEP HANDSHAKE (kernel + DEC07/DEC04 + opus-dec2/opus-kern): every LOCK_LAT/LOCK_CORE the vendor writes SMI larb SLP_CON (larb5 0x1600d00c, larb4 0x1602e00c presumably for core) bit0=1 and polls bit16 (ready) up to 50000 reads (libvcodec_utility vdec_hal_wait_larb_sleep_protect @0x292e8, release @0x2935c writes bit0=0). With the larb pages read-only or missing that is 2 x 50000 failed accesses per AU = ~100k ioctls per frame on the phone (and 0.25 s/AU CPU here). The 0x30000 window must therefore allow R/W of larb +0x00c (SLP_CON) at least; DEC07 "larb read-only" breaks decode. With a stand-in that acks bit16 the extra accesses disappear (bad 100320 -> 422 per AU).
